reason: The TRANS_B fast path has the clearest legal mapping: transpose A into the required column-major buffer, pass B directly, and test whether the timed conversion offsets the skipped B packing. The 320-byte scratch stride and store-order change are bounded experiments, but their benefits are uncertain. panel_packing and assembly_audit propose the same TB descriptor path; treat them as aliases, not separate experiments. The supplied panel layout needs careful verification against TB's expected B storage before implementation. The transpose-fusion proposal lacks a specified legal instruction sequence. TT and TA require two timed full-matrix transposes, so they rank lower. No proposal has measured benefit established by the supplied evidence.
